interpreter for the jq language that reads JSON from stdin and emits\nfiltered JSON values.\n\n## Command-line interface\n\nRun a filter in compact-output mode:\n\n```sh\n./jq -c '<program>' < input.json\n```\n\nThe program reads JSON values from standard input and writes each generated result as one\ncompact JSON value per line to standard output.
